label: THE DEFINITION OF DONE for the Scientific AI Harness, and a SOFTWARE contract. It says what must hold and which registry or evidence decides it; it states no status. The status is derived by tools/harness_status.py from stack.json, docs/completion_matrix.json, the audits and the learned-model status, and is never written by hand. No physical-apparatus output is an input to it.

outcomes.COMPLETE_TO_CURRENT_TECHNICALLY_DEFENSIB: every requirement below holds: every required stack element is in an accepted state, every matrix row is complete with hosted evidence covering its current implementation, every audit is clean and every fact holds
outcomes.BLOCKED: everything that is not satisfied is EXTERNALLY_BLOCKED (a demonstrated external blocker, recorded with the attempt) and nothing actionable remains
outcomes.INCOMPLETE: anything else: a STAGED, DEFERRED or unclassified required element, a row below complete, evidence that predates its implementation or was never run, an audit with a finding, a fact that does not hold

required_facts.learned_outputs_refused: docs/neural/claims.json learned_refused_states is exactly PROMOTED and VERIFIED, and the acceptance attempt was refused
required_facts.flagship_not_allocated_or_trained: docs/neural/current_status.json: flagship real weights not allocated, large model not trained
required_facts.flagship_architecture_as_declared: docs/neural/current_status.json reports exactly the declared flagship architecture below; the status is re-derived from the re-solved budget by tools/neural.py verify

outside_this_software_completion.statement: no physical experiment has been performed; nothing here is experimentally validated, and a software completion status is not scientific validity
the ~1T flagship is parameterised and meta-validated, never allocated or trained
the development model's scientific performance is unestablished and its epistemic uncertainty not assessed
no distributed accelerator hardware validation; tensor and pipeline parallelism are plans
byte identity of floating-point results on an arbitrary host is not guaranteed and not claimed
no admission policy for learned models exists; learned outputs stay NON_AUTHORITATIVE
a valid signature attests origin and integrity, never scientific validity
one FEniCSx benchmark does not verify every scientific model
